name: two conflicting birthdays: the newest goes live, the older is kept as history
description: Adversarial attribute-collision / split-detection probe. Two notes assert a different birthDate (attribute kind) for the SAME entity Cleo. ⟲ REWRITTEN for the owner's ruling on AGENT_INGEST_REWRITE §8 O15, and the old expectation is the behaviour he OVERRULED rather than a regression this edit papers over. It used to assert that BOTH sides go to pending_review ('two birthdays is a bug, not news'). Holding both left the key permanently contested: nothing on the box could retire either row — the conversation's sweep releases only what the note stops saying and the note still says both, no write verb retracts, and re-asserting a value hits decide()'s idempotency short-circuit on the held row — so Cleo served NO birthday at all, and the owner, who runs this box with no terminal, could see that and not fix it. His decision: \"It should default to the newest being live, but the note conversation that initiates the new fact should bring it up with the owner.\" So the newest STATEMENT (note B, captured 2026-02-20) is ACTIVE and note A's value is superseded and CHAINED to it — kept as history, never lost, and restorable through a card's accept_a arm on a producer that files one. Ordering is by reported_at, not validity: an attribute's `when` is routinely the value itself, so validity order would have ranked these two birthdays by which birthday they claim. DOCUMENTED GAP, unchanged: docs/reference/ANALYSIS.md 'Split detection' says conflicting attributes should propose an ENTITY SPLIT (hidden two-people merge), and the pipeline still has no entity_split review kind — the split is one answer the owner may give when he is asked. ONE CHANNEL (AGENT_INGEST_REWRITE R1b): the harness IS the note conversation, and a conversation's write path files no review card — decide() reports back in the tool result and the AGENT settles it, which since O15 means asking the owner which value is right. So the card count is still 0, and the ROW STATUSES above are the whole assertion.
